name: near-contract-review
skills: NEAR smart contracts in Rust: security review from a case-book of what audits of NEAR contracts have reported: callbacks and failed transfers, accounting and rounding, access and ownership, storage and registration, token assumptions, gas, limits and upgrades, configuration and pausing. Reviews attached code entry by entry, says who gains, who loses or what stops, and quotes the lines each finding rests on; answers questions about these mechanisms when no code is given.
examples: Is my ft_on_transfer safe if anyone can call it?
What breaks if a cross-contract call fails after my contract changed its state?
How much storage deposit should my contract take from each new user?
